imbuePoison.name: Poison Tip
imbuePoison.desc: Dip the Ranger's arrows — Poison the enemy.

bolster.name: Bolster
bolster.desc: Steel the Tank — applies Taunt and Defense to him.

unleash.name: Unleash
unleash.desc: Unleash the Mage's stored Charge as a Lightning Bolt.

hex.name: Evil Eye
hex.desc: The Warlock's Evil Eye applies Vulnerable to the enemy — deeper with fewer allies.

conduct.name: Conduct
conduct.desc: Cue the Busker's Crescendo — draw cards.

incite.name: Rile Up
incite.desc: Rile up the Berserker — a doubled strike at an HP cost.

beckon.name: Beckon
beckon.desc: Beckon the Beast Warden's Boar to soak hits at her side.

stagger.name: Halt!
stagger.desc: Through the Showstopper, Stun the enemy — cancel its telegraphed action.

enGarde.name: En Garde
enGarde.desc: Applies Taunt to a member and Riposte for {EN_GARDE_TURNS} turns — they counter every hit.

penance.name: Feat of Strength
penance.desc: Pay {PENANCE_HP} HP (no clamp — can kill him); every member's auto deals +{PENANCE_STRIKE_BONUS} for 2 turns.

twinShot.name: Twin Shot
twinShot.desc: The Ranger looses {TWIN_SHOT_HITS} arrows — she strikes twice (each takes Toxicologist).

concVenom.name: Concentrated Venom
concVenom.desc: Double the enemy's Poison-per-turn (its duration is unchanged).

shieldWall.name: Shield Wall
shieldWall.desc: Every living member gains Defense {SHIELD_WALL_DEFENSE} for {SHIELD_WALL_TURNS} enemy turns.

holdLine.name: Hold the Line
holdLine.desc: The Tank braces (Defense {HOLD_LINE_DEFENSE}, {HOLD_LINE_TURNS} turns); while it holds, damage he soaks banks double Grudge.

arcaneSurge.name: Arcane Surge
arcaneSurge.desc: The Mage gains {ARCANE_SURGE_CHARGE} Charge at once.

drainLife.name: Drain Life
drainLife.desc: Deal {DRAIN_LIFE_DMG} (more if Vulnerable); the most wounded member heals for the damage dealt.

doom.name: Doom
doom.desc: Curse the enemy: after {DOOM_DELAY} enemy turns it takes {DOOM_DAMAGE} damage (its Vulnerability then scales it).

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.desc: An ally pays {SACRIFICE_HP} HP (min 1); the Warlock gains +{SACRIFICE_DMG} damage & +{SACRIFICE_POWER} ability power this fight. One use.

finale.name: Finale
finale.desc: The Busker strikes for {FINALE_MULT}× his cards-played value this turn.

duet.name: Duet
duet.desc: A chosen other member immediately makes a bonus auto-attack.

bloodbath.name: Bloodbath
bloodbath.desc: The Berserker strikes for his MISSING HP — the more hurt, the harder it hits.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: The Berserker strikes {WHIRLWIND_HITS}× (a 3rd time while in his hottest rage band).

sicEm.name: Sic 'Em
sicEm.desc: The Beast Warden's Boar lunges — deal {SIC_EM_MULT}× its strike bonus to the enemy.

mendBeast.name: Mend Beast
mendBeast.desc: Heal the Boar {MEND_BEAST_HEAL} and extend its stay by 1 enemy turn.

standingOvation.name: Standing Ovation
standingOvation.desc: Every living member's next attack this turn lands doubled.

bigTop.name: Big Top
bigTop.desc: The whole party takes {BIG_TOP_DR} less from every hit for the next enemy turn.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.desc: The Duelist strikes for {LUNGE_MULT}× and applies Taunt to herself for {LUNGE_TAUNT_TURNS} turns.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: The Duelist strikes {FLURRY_HITS} times, each for her auto − {FLURRY_REDUCTION}.

strongest.name: Strongest in the World
strongest.desc: Pay {STRONGEST_HP} HP (no clamp — can kill him); every member's auto lands doubled this turn.

deadlift.name: Deadlift
deadlift.desc: Hoist a chosen ally clear — the enemy cannot target them next enemy turn.

regen.name: Regen
regen.desc: Regen +2: heal 2, then 1, decaying each turn. Adds to an existing Regen.

shield.name: Shield
shield.desc: Fully block the next attack instance on a member.

resurrect.name: Resurrect
resurrect.desc: Revive a dead member to 50% max HP.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.desc: Remove all negative status effects from the party.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.desc: Consume a member's Regen: heal them for its full remaining amount at once.

fontOfMana.name: Refresh
fontOfMana.desc: Restore 3 MP per turn for 3 enemy turns.

lifebloom.name: Lifebloom
lifebloom.desc: Regen +2 (decays each turn); when it ends while the target lives, burst-heal 3.

battleHymn.name: Fight Song
battleHymn.desc: Every living member's attack this turn deals +2.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.desc: Every living member gains a Shield; unused ones fade after the next enemy phase.

bloodTithe.name: Elbow Grease
bloodTithe.desc: A member with more than 4 HP pays 4 HP; restore 2 MP.

martyrsGift.name: Helping Hand
martyrsGift.desc: A member with more than 3 HP pays 3 HP; every other living member heals 4.

phalanx.name: Turtle Up
phalanx.desc: Defense 2 for 2 enemy turns. Cannot target a defended or taunting member.

provoke.name: Provoke
provoke.desc: Applies Taunt to the target for 2 enemy turns.

feint.name: Feint
feint.desc: Redirect every hit of the standing telegraph onto the target member.

sporeburst.name: Sporeburst
sporeburst.desc: Consume the target's Regen; Poison the enemy {SPOREBURST_POISON}/turn for as many turns as ticks consumed.

hemorrhage.name: Goo Burst
hemorrhage.desc: Consume the enemy's Poison and deal its whole remaining damage at once.

dreadWhisper.name: Trash Talk
dreadWhisper.desc: The standing telegraph deals {DREAD_WHISPER_REDUCTION} less per target (min 0).

crimsonPact.name: Paper Cuts
crimsonPact.desc: A member with more than {CRIMSON_PACT_HP} HP pays {CRIMSON_PACT_HP} HP; draw {CRIMSON_PACT_DRAW}.

scarletWard.name: Thick Skin
scarletWard.desc: A member with more than {SCARLET_WARD_HP} HP pays {SCARLET_WARD_HP} HP; gain a Shield.

transfusion.name: Blood Drive
transfusion.desc: A member with more than {TRANSFUSION_HP} HP pays {TRANSFUSION_HP} HP; the most wounded other member heals {TRANSFUSION_HEAL}.

bloodBanner.name: Pep Rally
bloodBanner.desc: Every living member pays {BLOOD_BANNER_HP} HP (clamps to 1); the party's autos deal +{BLOOD_BANNER_BONUS} for {BLOOD_BANNER_TURNS} enemy turns.

sunriseVigil.name: Special Delivery
sunriseVigil.desc: At the start of your next turn, heal every living member {SUNRISE_VIGIL_HEAL}.

consecration.name: Glow Up
consecration.desc: Heal all {CONSECRATION_HEAL}; members at full HP afterward gain +{CONSECRATION_STRIKE_BONUS} auto for {CONSECRATION_STRIKE_TURNS} enemy turns.

arcaneLens.name: Arcane Lens
arcaneLens.desc: Your next single-target heal this turn also hits the most wounded other member.

mendingStream.name: Mending Stream
mendingStream.desc: Channel: heal a member {MENDING_STREAM_HEAL}/turn (up to {MENDING_STREAM_MAX_TURNS}). Ends on death or any card.

sap.name: Sap
sap.desc: Channel: each turn the enemy grows +{SAP_VULN_PER_TICK|pct}% Vulnerable (up to +{SAP_VULN_CAP|pct}%), for {SAP_MAX_TURNS} turns. Ends on any card.

guard.name: Guard
guard.desc: A hero takes {GUARD_DR} less damage per hit for {GUARD_TURNS} enemy turns. Stacks with Defense, not with itself.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.desc: A hero's attacks deal +{SHARPEN_BONUS} for {SHARPEN_TURNS} enemy turns.

doubleStrike.name: Encore
doubleStrike.desc: A hero's next basic attack lands doubled, then is spent.

empower.name: Empower
empower.desc: A hero's next ability fires at +{EMPOWER_BONUS} ability power, then is spent.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: The next attack that hits a hero, they counterattack for their damage.
